videos.t: How to 3D print a Green Goblin Helmet - Pt 1: Printing and Sanding
videos.desc:
Well after 3 months of finishing college and having fun being an adult I am happy to finally sit back down to focus of sharing builds! This episode is the first of 3 going over the process to make a full 3D printed green goblin helmet an focuses on printing, welding, and sanding the helmet. Episodes two and 3 will be on final finishing, painting, and assembly! Hope you guys enjoy and thank you for being so patient. 

As always thank you all so much for the support on this new adventure with me. 
you can find the model used in this video, (along with many other amazing models) on Vek3d's Instag

videos.t: Making a Movie Accurate Green Goblin Helmet | Pt: 2 Sanding and Prep
videos.desc:
Alrighty part 2 is here! In this build we go over how to prep all the 3D printed parts with using filler primers and sanding to get the build ready for the final paint job! Hope you guys enjoy and thank you for being so patient. If you have suggestions for other builds and cosplays I should take on or have any questions let me know below!

As always thank you all so much for the support on this new adventure with me. WE ARE ALMOST AT 1K SUBS!

videos.desc:
The final (and probably most important) episode in the Goblin Helmet series, The paint! This was by far the most common question I received while working on this helmet so I am happy to finally have this video up to help anyone working on their own builds. 

If you haven't already seen Frank's video on his Goblin Helmet (lets be honest you probably have) be sure to check it out! We took a different approach on the final paint choices so be sure to check out the differences and let us know what you think!

videos.t: Iron Idiots EP#6 | Real Jobs and Life off Social Media!
videos.desc:
What's life like on the other side of the screen? We thought it would be interesting to talk about the sides of our lives that don't always make it on to our main platforms. Join us in this episode to learn more about our lives off of social media! Work, school, and projects and more! 

This weeks episode is a little longer than usual as we chose to go a bit of a different route by having a more formal topic. Let me know what you guys think! We are planning to have some guests on the show in the coming episodes so it will be good to know if you prefer the longer or shorter style of episodes.

videos.t: Iron Idiots EP#7 |  PLA Peeps vs PETG Gang
videos.desc:
In this episode we share some personal experiences with printing different materials over the years and debate the question of whether PLA is becoming a crutch or a god send for the 3D printing community as it compares to other popular materials. Are you a member of the PLA peeps or part of the PETG gang? Let us know in the comments below!

Expect a gaming themed video and live stream in the next couple episodes!
